archive.contents: Exactly the two enriched JSON files below; no raw media, emails, QA fixtures, stores or credentials.

fusion.other_fields: Every non-caption field and the exact original caption are retained from the pinned released annotations.
fusion.released_model_field_scope: The retained model_used field identifies the original released SGM annotation stage, not the additional-description generator.

reconstruction.method: Before the measured run, recover each caption from the authoritative stored source text using the source ID and fixed SGM header/OCR/tag boundaries; replace only the released record's caption. No model calls.
reconstruction.verification: Reconstructed source text after SDK normalization, metadata, timestamps, raw asset bytes and canonical embeddings matched the retained source store. The measured run recorded the reconstructed JSON hashes listed above.

original_description_generation.status: Historical generation records are incomplete. The exact generation recipe and its input-access boundary cannot be established; the supplied inputs preserve the evaluated content for inspection.
original_description_generation.limitation: Source-only reconstruction and runtime ingestion do not establish that the earlier description generation was question-blind or label-blind.
